column4: 孩子们在院子里四处跑。
column5: The children are running all over the yard.
column6: 四处 means "in all directions, everywhere": 四处找 (to look everywhere), 四处看 (to look around). 到处 is similar.

column5: He does not seem very happy.
column6: 似乎 means "it seems, apparently": 似乎知道 (seems to know), 似乎很累 (seems very tired). It is more formal than 好像.

column5: Trees are all around the house.
column6: 四周 means "all around, the surroundings": 看看四周 (to look around), 四周很安静 (it is quiet all around).

column5: He did a search on his phone.
column6: 搜 is to search, mostly used on a phone or computer: 搜一下 (to search it), 搜一搜 (to have a search). 找 is "to look for"; 搜 needs a search tool.

column4: 请在网上搜索这个问题。
column5: Please search for this question online.
column6: 搜索 is to search for information: 搜索信息 (to search for information), 网上搜索 (to search online). It is the longer, more formal form of 搜.

column5: We live in the same dormitory.
column6: 宿舍 is a dormitory: 学生宿舍 (a student dormitory), 宿舍楼 (a dormitory building).

column3: sweet, sour, bitter and spicy; life's ups and downs
column5: Life has its sweet, sour, bitter and spicy moments.
column6: 酸甜苦辣 are the four tastes: sour, sweet, bitter, spicy. It also stands for all the joys and sorrows of life: 生活的酸甜苦辣.

column3: to follow; to go along with
column5: The child went to Shanghai with his mother.
column6: 随 is to follow or go along with: 随着 (as; along with), 随我来 (follow me), 随便 (as you like).

column4: 他先说了几句，随后就走了。
column5: He said a few words first and then left.
column6: 随后 means "soon afterwards" and joins two actions in a row: 随后就 (and then right away), 随后来 (to come afterwards). 然后 is the everyday word.

column5: If you have a question, you can ask me at any time.
column6: 随时 means "at any time": 随时来 (to come at any time), 随时准备 (always ready), 随时联系 (to contact at any time).

column4: 出门的时候，请随手关灯。
column5: On leaving, please turn off the light on the way out.
column6: 随手 means doing something at once, in passing: 随手关门 (to shut the door behind one), 随手放 (to put down without thinking).

column5: Everyone, please feel free to sit anywhere.
column6: 随意 means "as one pleases": 请随意 (please feel free), 随意选 (to choose freely), 不要太随意 (not too casual).

column5: The cup fell on the floor and broke into pieces.
column6: 碎 is to break into pieces, or broken: 打碎 (to smash), 碎了 (broken), 碎纸 (scraps of paper).

column5: Bad habits can harm health.
column6: 损害 is to harm something valuable, such as health or a relationship: 损害健康 (to harm health), 损害关系 (to damage a relationship). 伤害 hurts people; 损害 damages things.

column4: 大雨给农民带来了很大的损失。
column5: The heavy rain brought farmers great losses.
column6: 损失 is a loss of money or things (noun), or to lose (verb): 损失很大 (a big loss), 减少损失 (to reduce losses).

column4: 我们可以缩短会议的时间。
column5: We can shorten the meeting time.
column6: 缩短 is to make something shorter: 缩短时间 (to shorten the time), 缩短会议 (to shorten a meeting).

column4: 请把这张照片缩小一点。
column5: Please make this photo a little smaller.
column6: 缩小 is to make smaller: 缩小照片 (to shrink a photo), 缩小差别 (to narrow the difference).

column5: This is a new school.
column6: 所 counts schools and hospitals: 一所学校 (a school), 一所医院 (a hospital). It is also in 所有 (all) and 所以 (so).

column5: Please lock the door.
column6: 锁 is a lock (noun) or to lock (verb): 一把锁 (a lock), 锁门 (to lock the door), 锁好 (to lock properly).

column4: 帮助他人是一件快乐的事。
column5: Helping others is a happy thing.
column6: 他人 means "other people", in writing: 关心他人 (to care about others), 帮助他人 (to help others). 别人 is the everyday word.

column5: There is a desk lamp on the table.
column6: 台灯 is a desk lamp: 开台灯 (to turn on the lamp), 一个台灯 (a desk lamp).

column5: He walked up the steps.
column6: 台阶 are outdoor steps: 上台阶 (to go up the steps), 小心台阶 (watch the steps). 楼梯 are indoor stairs.

column5: This lady is my neighbour.
column6: 太太 is a married woman, or "wife" (said by her husband): 太太们 (the ladies), 我太太 (my wife). It is read tàitai, with a neutral second syllable.

column3: to talk; to have a talk
column5: The teacher wants to have a talk with you.
column6: 谈话 is a serious talk between two people: 找他谈话 (to ask him for a talk), 谈话时 (during the talk). 聊天 is relaxed chatting.

column5: This peach is very sweet.
column6: 桃 is a peach: 一个桃 (a peach), 吃桃 (to eat a peach).

column5: I bought a new set of clothes.
column6: 套 is a measure word for sets: 一套衣服 (a suit of clothes), 一套书 (a set of books), 一套房子 (a flat). As a verb it means to put a cover over: 套上 (to slip on).

column5: This is a speciality of my hometown.
column6: 特产 is a food or product a place is known for: 当地特产 (the local speciality), 买特产 (to buy specialities).

column5: The dishes at this restaurant have real character.
column6: 特色 is a special, characteristic quality: 有特色 (to have character), 特色菜 (a signature dish), 地方特色 (local colour).

column4: 今天是一个特殊的日子。
column5: Today is a special day.
column6: 特殊 means special, unlike the usual: 特殊的日子 (a special day), 特殊情况 (a special case), 很特殊 (very special). 特别 is "especially"; 特殊 is "unusual in kind".

column4: 这是这个地方特有的水果。
column5: This is a fruit that is special to this place.
column6: 特有 means "belonging only to": 特有的 (unique to), 中国特有 (unique to China).

column4: 这个人的特征是个子很高。
column5: This person's main feature is being very tall.
column6: 特征 is a distinguishing feature: 主要特征 (the main feature), 特征明显 (an obvious feature).

column5: After taking the medicine, the pain lessened.
column6: 疼痛 is pain, a more formal word than 疼: 感到疼痛 (to feel pain), 减少疼痛 (to reduce pain).

column5: The school encourages everyone to read more.
column6: 提倡 is to promote something as a good thing to do: 提倡读书 (to encourage reading), 提倡运动 (to encourage exercise).

column4: 请在明天以前提交作业。
column5: Please hand in your homework before tomorrow.
column6: 提交 is to submit work or a form to someone: 提交作业 (to hand in homework), 提交申请 (to submit an application).

column5: This question is very hard.
column6: 题目 is a topic or an exam question: 考试题目 (an exam question), 文章题目 (the title of an article).

column4: 提起这件事，他就很生气。
column5: Whenever this matter is mentioned, he gets angry.
column6: 提起 is to bring up a topic: 提起这件事 (to mention this matter), 不要提起 (do not bring it up).

column4: 他的汉语水平提升了很多。
column5: His level of Chinese has improved a lot.
column6: 提升 is to raise something to a higher level: 提升水平 (to raise the level), 提升能力 (to improve ability). The opposite is 下降.

column4: 同学们可以向老师提问。
column5: Students can ask the teacher questions.
column6: 提问 is to ask a question, usually in class: 向老师提问 (to put a question to the teacher), 提问题 (to raise a question).

column4: 这种快乐，只有自己去体会。
column5: This kind of joy can only be understood by feeling it oneself.
column6: 体会 is to understand by feeling or experiencing it: 体会到 (to come to realise), 深刻的体会 (a deep understanding).

column5: Climbing mountains needs a lot of physical strength.
column6: 体力 is physical strength or stamina: 体力好 (strong stamina), 花体力 (to use up strength).

column4: 这件事体现了他的善良。
column5: This matter has shown his kindness.
column6: 体现 is to show or embody a quality in action: 体现出 (to show), 体现了 (has shown).

column4: 我想体验一下中国的生活。
column5: I want to experience life in China.
column6: 体验 is to experience something yourself: 体验生活 (to experience life), 新体验 (a new experience).

column3: to do for; on behalf of
column5: I am going to the meeting in your place.
column6: 替 means "in place of, for": 替我 (for me), 替你高兴 (to be happy for you). The pattern is 替 + person + verb.

column5: The sky is very blue.
column6: 天空 is the sky: 蓝蓝的天空 (a blue sky), 天空中 (in the sky).

column5: There are many clouds in the sky.
column6: 天上 is "in the sky" and works as a place word: 天上有 (there is … in the sky), 在天上 (in the sky). 天空 is "the sky" as a thing.

column5: Please fill in this form.
column6: 填 is to fill in a form or a blank: 填表 (to fill in a form), 填空 (to fill in the blank), 填名字 (to write in a name).

column5: I like eating desserts.
column6: 甜品 is a dessert or sweet snack: 吃甜品 (to eat dessert), 甜品店 (a dessert shop).

column5: He is choosing apples in the fruit shop.
column6: 挑 is to pick out the best: 挑东西 (to pick things), 挑一个 (to pick one). 选 is "to choose"; 挑 is carefully picking among many.

column5: Please take your time choosing; there is no hurry.
column6: 挑选 is to select carefully: 挑选衣服 (to pick clothes), 挑选礼物 (to choose a gift).

column5: This child is very naughty.
column6: 调皮 means naughty, in a playful way: 调皮的孩子 (a naughty child), 很调皮 (very mischievous). 调 is read tiáo here.

column5: We need to adjust the time a little.
column6: 调整 is to adjust: 调整时间 (to adjust the time), 调整办法 (to adjust the method). 调 is read tiáo in 调整 and 空调; on its own it is diào (to transfer).

column5: This is a big challenge.
column6: 挑战 is a challenge, or to challenge: 接受挑战 (to accept a challenge), 面对挑战 (to face a challenge).

column5: He does the high jump very well.
column6: 跳高 is the high jump: 参加跳高比赛 (to take part in the high jump), 跳高 (to do the high jump). It is a verb-object word. 跳远 is the long jump.

column4: 他在学校的跳远比赛中得了第一名。
column5: He came first in the school's long jump competition.
column6: 跳远 is the long jump: 跳远比赛 (a long jump competition), 跳远跳了五米 (to jump five metres).

column5: Please stick the photo on the wall.
column6: 贴 is to stick or paste: 贴照片 (to stick photos), 贴在 (to stick onto), 贴好 (to stick well).

column5: This railway is very long.
column6: 铁路 is a railway: 一条铁路 (a railway), 修铁路 (to build a railway). 火车站 is the station.

column3: to stay briefly; to stop over
column5: He stayed in Shanghai for three days.
column6: 停留 is to stay at a place for a short time: 停留三天 (to stay three days), 停留一会儿 (to stop for a moment).

column5: I usually get up at seven.
column6: 通常 means "usually, normally": 通常来说 (generally speaking), 通常都 (usually all). 平时 is similar.

column3: to pass; to be open to traffic
column5: Traffic cannot pass on this road today.
column6: 通行 is to pass along a road or a place: 不能通行 (closed to traffic), 可以通行 (open to traffic).

column5: They live in the same dormitory.
column6: 同 means "same" (同岁, the same age), "together" (同住, to live together) and, in writing, "with" (同他说, to talk with him). It is also in 同学, 同事 and 同意.

column5: I sympathise with him a lot.
column6: 同情 is to feel sorry for someone's bad luck: 同情他 (to sympathise with him), 得到同情 (to receive sympathy).

column5: We live in the same city.
column6: 同一 means exactly the same one: 同一个人 (the same person), 同一时间 (at the same time). 同样 is "the same kind".

column4: 老师在统计大家的成绩。
column5: The teacher is totalling everyone's results.
column6: 统计 is to count and add up figures: 统计人数 (to count the number of people), 统计数据 (to compile data).

column4: 我们要统一大家的想法。
column5: We need to unify everyone's ideas.
column6: 统一 is to make into one, or unified: 统一时间 (to fix one time for all), 统一意见 (to agree on an opinion).

column5: He is suffering deeply inside.
column6: 痛苦 means painful, in body or mind: 感到痛苦 (to feel pain), 痛苦的事 (a painful matter).

column5: I cast my vote for him.
column6: 投 is to throw or cast: 投票 (to vote), 投球 (to throw a ball), 投钱 (to put money in).

column5: He is very absorbed in his work.
column6: 投入 is to put in effort or money (verb), and "absorbed" (adjective): 投入时间 (to put in time), 很投入 (very devoted).

column5: His results are outstanding.
column6: 突出 means outstanding, or to stress: 突出的问题 (a prominent problem), 突出重点 (to stress the main point).

column5: A drawing is hanging on the wall.
column6: 图画 is a picture or drawing: 一张图画 (a picture), 画图画 (to draw a picture).

column5: There are many books here.
column6: 图书 means books as a group, for example in a shop or library: 图书馆 (a library), 新图书 (new books).

column5: The land here is very good.
column6: 土地 is land or soil: 一块土地 (a piece of land), 保护土地 (to protect land).

column5: I like eating potatoes.
column6: 土豆 is a potato: 吃土豆 (to eat potatoes), 炒土豆 (to stir-fry potatoes).

column5: There is a rabbit on the grass.
column6: 兔子 is a rabbit: 一只兔子 (a rabbit), 小兔子 (a bunny).

column5: Our group has twenty people.
column6: 团 is a group or organisation (团里, in the group) and a ball-shaped thing (一团, a ball of). In 团队 it means a team.

column4: 我们团队的人都很努力。
column5: Everyone in our team works very hard.
column6: 团队 is a team working together: 团队精神 (team spirit), 一个团队 (a team). 队 is a line or a team.

column4: 科学推动了社会的发展。
column5: Science has driven the development of society.
column6: 推动 is to push something forward: 推动发展 (to promote development), 推动工作 (to push work forward).
